level.theme: Eerie and decaying alchemical lab with flickering lights, rusted machinery, and whispers echoing from the walls.
level.setting: A once-thriving alchemical laboratory now turned into a cursed and decaying tomb, filled with dangerous experiments and twisted remnants of past experiments.
level.player_weapon: Eldritch Crucible (a magical furnace capable of transmuting matter into volatile alchemical compounds)

enemy.name: Vapor Wraith
enemy.weakness: Alchemical Catalyst (a glowing vial found in a nearby cabinet)

encounters.hazard: Fog that causes confusion and reduces vision

pickup.name: Alchemical Catalyst
pickup.effect: Can be used in the Eldritch Crucible to create a powerful explosive reaction

encounters.trigger: Destroy the corrupted alembic in the center of the room to unlock the path to the next area.

enemy.name: Soulbound Apprentice
enemy.weakness: Eldritch Crucible's alchemical fire (from previous pickup)

encounters.hazard: Traps triggered by the enemy's movements

pickup.name: Tome of Forbidden Mixtures
pickup.effect: Provides a formula for a powerful alchemical explosive

encounters.trigger: Decipher the corrupted alchemical notes on the desk to unlock the door to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Corrupted Master Alchemist
enemy.weakness: Tome of Forbidden Mixtures (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: A collapsing ceiling with falling debris

pickup.name: Grand Alchemical Formula
pickup.effect: Unlocks a powerful alchemical reaction in the Eldritch Crucible

encounters.trigger: The enemy will summon lesser spirits if the player fails to use the Tome correctly, increasing the difficulty.

boss.name: The Corrupted Master Alchemist
boss.weakness: Grand Alchemical Formula (from the previous encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Grand Alchemical Formula in the Eldritch Crucible to trigger a chain reaction that defeats the boss

level.objective: Navigate through the cursed alchemist's workshop and defeat the corrupted master alchemist, using your knowledge of alchemy and your tools to survive.
level.reward: The player gains the ability to craft permanent alchemical upgrades to their weapon, and access to a new alchemical formula library.

level.theme: Ominous and oppressive, filled with whispers, flickering flames, and the ever-present threat of fire and collapse.
level.setting: Ancient, crumbling catacombs lined with ash, molten veins, and ancient fire altars that glow with unstable energy.
level.player_weapon: Ember Brand - a flaming longsword that can channel fire essence.

enemy.name: Ash Wraith
enemy.weakness: Flame Vulnerability (Ember Brand)

encounters.hazard: The walls of the catacombs are coated in unstable ash, which ignite when the player walks on them, dealing 10 fire damage per step.

pickup.name: Fire Core
pickup.effect: Grants +15 fire damage to Ember Brand for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Ash Wraith is defeated, and its essence is absorbed by the fire core, causing the walls to ignite and revealing a hidden passage leading deeper into the catacombs.

enemy.name: Dread Pyre
enemy.weakness: Ash Wraith's Essence (Pickup from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: The floor is cracked and unstable, periodically collapsing and revealing pits of molten lava.

pickup.name: Wraith's Echo
pickup.effect: Temporarily imbues the player with the Ash Wraith's essence, granting +25% damage against fire-based enemies.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating Dread Pyre, the echoes of the Ash Wraith resonate with the fire core, causing the core to pulse with energy and unlock a portal to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Maelgris, the Corrupted Flame
enemy.weakness: Fire Core (Pickup from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with swirling embers and unstable fire magic, occasionally creating firestorms that deal 20 damage over 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Emberheart Crystal
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and permanently increases Ember Brand's fire damage by 20.

encounters.trigger: The fire core, when placed in the altar of the sanctum, disrupts Maelgris's corrupted form and allows the player to strike a fatal blow.

boss.name: Maelgris, the Corrupted Flame
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Maelgris by exploiting his weakness to the Fire Core, using the amplified Ember Brand.

level.objective: Survive the Ashen Catacombs and defeat the corrupted fire spirit, Maelgris, using the knowledge and pickups acquired from previous encounters.
level.reward: Emberheart Crystal and access to the next level of the Ashen Catacombs.

level.theme: A gothic cathedral haunted by the spirits of those who sought immortality through dark means.
level.setting: Dark, echoing halls, flickering candlelight, hidden doors, and spectral visions.
level.player_weapon: Shadowdagger – a weapon that drains life from enemies and leaves trails of darkness that can be used to hide from enemies.

enemy.name: Wraith of the First Priest
enemy.weakness: The player must use the Shadowdagger's life-drain ability to damage it. If the player fails to do so, the wraith becomes intangible.

encounters.hazard: The atrium is filled with shifting shadows. If the player steps into the wrong shadow, they will be teleported to the center of the room.

pickup.name: Ethereal Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see hidden paths and see through illusions for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the wraith, a hidden door opens, revealing the next area.

enemy.name: Scribe of the Dead
enemy.weakness: The enemy is vulnerable to the Ethereal Lens. If the player uses the Lens to reveal the scribe’s true form, they can damage it with normal attacks.

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with bookshelves that occasionally collapse, creating impassable debris.

pickup.name: Cursed Quill
pickup.effect: A cursed writing tool that can be used to inscribe runes that weaken the final boss.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the scribe, the library door locks and a spectral voice announces the arrival of the final guardian.

enemy.name: The Forgotten One – Boss
enemy.weakness: The boss is vulnerable to the runes inscribed with the Cursed Quill. The player must use the quill to etch a rune on the altar in the sanctum before engaging in battle.

encounters.hazard: The sanctum is a large, circular chamber with a central altar and pillars that pulse with dark energy. The boss periodically summons shadow clones that must be dispelled with the Shadowdagger’s trail of darkness.

pickup.name: Relic of the Forgotten
pickup.effect: The player's objective. Once retrieved, it allows them to escape the cathedral.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the boss unlocks the relic and opens a portal to escape.

boss.name: The Forgotten One
boss.weakness: The runes inscribed with the Cursed Quill.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss and retrieve the Relic of the Forgotten.

level.objective: Survive the haunted cathedral and escape with the stolen relic.
level.reward: Escape the cathedral and survive with the relic intact.

level.theme: Desolate, cursed forest filled with ancient ruins and corrupted nature spirits.
level.setting: A dense, decaying forest with overgrown ruins, glowing fungi, and eerie silence broken only by distant howls.

enemy.name: Wraithroot
enemy.weakness: Shadow Arrow (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Dense fog reduces visibility by 50% and increases enemy detection chance.

pickup.name: Ancient Rune Token
pickup.effect: Unlocks a hidden path toward the next area.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Wraithroot causes a nearby tree to collapse, revealing a hidden tunnel leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Cursed Druid
enemy.weakness: Ancient Rune Token (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: The shrine is unstable and collapses after 2 minutes of being in the area.

pickup.name: Fey Lantern
pickup.effect: Illuminates hidden glyphs in the next area, revealing a weakness.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Cursed Druid with the rune token unlocks an ancient glyph that glows and leads to the final area.

enemy.name: Erynthian Warden
enemy.weakness: Fey Lantern (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: The ground pulses with dark energy, causing periodic shockwaves that stagger the player.

pickup.name: Erynthian Key
pickup.effect: Opens the final gate to escape the forest.

encounters.trigger: Using the Fey Lantern to reveal the weakness allows the player to strike the warden’s core, triggering the final collapse of the forest and the escape.

boss.name: Erynthian Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the warden using the Fey Lantern's light to expose the weakness, then use the Erynthian Key to escape the collapsing forest.

level.objective: Survive and escape the cursed forest of Erynthia, while uncovering the source of the ancient ritual that awakened the horrors.

level.theme: Mysterious, eerie, and layered with spectral whispers that hint at deeper secrets waiting to be uncovered.
level.setting: A decaying, fog-laden graveyard filled with crypts, shrines, and ancient ruins that pulse with necromantic energy.
level.player_weapon: Soulbrand – a cursed staff that channels necromantic energy, capable of raising the dead as allies or unleashing spectral attacks.

enemy.name: Wraithling
enemy.weakness: Soulbrand’s spectral resonance

encounters.hazard: Echoes of the dead whisper secrets that disorient the player.

pickup.name: Fetid Grimoire
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new necromantic spell: 'Soul Shatter' which deals 25 damage to a single enemy.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Wraithling, the crypt door creaks open, revealing the path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Bound Spirit
enemy.weakness: Fetid Grimoire’s Soul Shatter spell

encounters.hazard: The shrine is guarded by ancient runes that trap the player in a spectral loop if touched.

pickup.name: Cursed Relic
pickup.effect: When equipped, reduces the damage from the final boss by 20.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Bound Spirit, the shrine collapses, revealing the final boss chamber.

enemy.name: The Hollow Lord
enemy.weakness: Cursed Relic

encounters.hazard: The graveyard trembles as the Hollow Lord rises, summoning shadows to attack.

pickup.name: Eternal Soul
pickup.effect: Gives the player an eternal ally that fights alongside them for the rest of the game.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Hollow Lord awakens the eternal soul, sealing the graveyard’s curse.

boss.name: The Hollow Lord
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollow Lord using the Cursed Relic obtained earlier.

level.objective: Survive three encounters and defeat the final boss, uncovering the secrets of the haunted graveyard.
level.reward: Eternal Soul, mastery of a new necromantic spell, and the graveyard is now safe from further corruption.

level.theme: Chaotic, claustrophobic, and overwhelming. The level is filled with disorienting sound effects, flickering lights, and unpredictable enemy patterns that escalate in intensity as the player progresses.
level.setting: A once-sacred cathedral now corrupted by an ancient, malevolent force. The architecture is warped and broken, with grotesque carvings and bloodstains on the walls. The air is thick with the scent of decay and desperation.

enemy.name: Cultist of the Maw
enemy.weakness: The player must use the 'Shattered Mirror' pickup found in this encounter.

encounters.hazard: The altar is unstable, causing periodic tremors that reduce player movement speed by 30%.

pickup.name: Shattered Mirror
pickup.effect: Reflects 50% of enemy damage back at them for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the cultist, a hidden door opens in the cathedral's nave, revealing the next encounter.

enemy.name: The Whispering Warden
enemy.weakness: The player must use the 'Chaotic Cleaver' weapon on the enemy's exposed back.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with hallucinogenic mist that causes random attacks to miss with 30% chance.

pickup.name: Fractured Bell
pickup.effect: When activated, it releases a shockwave that stuns enemies for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, the ground collapses, revealing the final boss.

enemy.name: The Hollow Choir
enemy.weakness: The player must use the 'Fractured Bell' pickup from the previous encounter to stun the boss.

encounters.hazard: The boss emits a sonic wave that reduces player health by 20 every 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Soul of the First Warden
pickup.effect: Upon defeating the boss, the player gains a permanent +20% damage boost and 30% increased health.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the boss, the cathedral collapses, and the player escapes with the Soul of the First Warden.

boss.name: The Hollow Choir
boss.weakness: The boss is vulnerable to sound-based attacks and exposed back strikes.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the 'Fractured Bell' pickup to stun them, then use the 'Chaotic Cleaver' to deliver the killing blow.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic nightmare of the Ruined Cathedral, defeating three horrors and the final boss, The Hollow Choir. Each encounter must be overcome by utilizing knowledge from the previous one.
level.reward: Soul of the First Warden - permanent boost to player's damage and health, unlocks access to a new weapon skin for the Chaotic Cleaver.

level.theme: Serene horror – the environment appears quiet and almost peaceful, but every stillness is laced with subtle, unsettling sounds and the feeling that something is watching from the shadows.
level.setting: Abandoned sanatorium in a fog-drenched forest, with decaying grandeur and overgrown paths that seem to lead nowhere.
level.player_weapon: Heavy Warden's Gauntlet – a reinforced gauntlet with a built-in plasma core, capable of disrupting psychic energy and spiritual entities.

enemy.name: Echo Specter
enemy.weakness: Plasma energy – the Warden's Gauntlet's core can disrupt its form.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and whispers that create illusions of the player's past.

pickup.name: Echo Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to see through illusions. Can be used to activate the locked door to the basement.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Echo Specter, the illusion dissolves, revealing a hidden door that leads to the basement.

enemy.name: Bound Wraith
enemy.weakness: Physical impact – the Warden's Gauntlet's reinforced grip can break the chains binding the wraith.

encounters.hazard: Frost-covered surfaces that reduce movement speed and cause cold damage over time.

pickup.name: Chainbreaker Token
pickup.effect: Increases physical damage by 15% and can be used to break the chains binding the final boss.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Bound Wraith, the chains on the sealed door to the archive chamber rattle and begin to loosen, preparing the way for the final confrontation.

enemy.name: The Keeper
enemy.weakness: The Chainbreaker Token – only this item can break the chains that bind The Keeper's spirit, making it vulnerable to direct attack.

encounters.hazard: A swirling vortex of psychic energy that drains the player's stamina and causes hallucinations.

pickup.name: Sealed Archive
pickup.effect: Completes the mission objective. Contains the truth about the sanatorium's dark past.

encounters.trigger: The final confrontation with The Keeper requires the Chainbreaker Token acquired in the previous encounter.

boss.name: The Keeper
boss.weakness: Chainbreaker Token – only this item can break the chains that bind The Keeper's spirit, making it vulnerable to direct attack.
boss.victory_condition: Break the chains binding The Keeper using the Chainbreaker Token, then deliver a final strike with the Warden's Gauntlet.

level.objective: Secure the abandoned sanatorium and retrieve the sealed archive from the basement, but be wary of the spirits that dwell in the halls.
level.reward: Sealed Archive and a brief vision of the sanatorium's true history, revealing the source of the spirits' torment.

level.theme: A whimsical horror carnival filled with illusions, shifting realities, and playful terror.
level.setting: A floating carnival with endless mirrors, puppet shows that come to life, and a final confrontation with a sentient illusion.

enemy.name: Echo Golem
enemy.weakness: Mirror of Reflections (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Shifting mirrors cause confusion and self-doubt.

pickup.name: Carnival Ticket
pickup.effect: Grants access to the next section of the carnival.

encounters.trigger: After defeating Echo Golem, the Carnival Ticket glows and unlocks the gate to the next area.

enemy.name: Puppeteer of Whispers
enemy.weakness: Carnival Ticket (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: Puppet strings pull the player into a nightmare dream sequence.

pickup.name: Ring of Distortion
pickup.effect: Allows the player to create a small illusionary barrier.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Puppeteer causes the Ring of Distortion to fall from the sky, which then unlocks the path to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Whimsical Warden
enemy.weakness: Ring of Distortion (from prior pickup)

encounters.hazard: The Warden conjures a maze of changing paths and illusions.

pickup.name: Crown of Reflections
pickup.effect: Grants the player the ability to see through illusions.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Warden reveals the Crown of Reflections, which allows the player to escape the carnival with clarity.

boss.name: Whimsical Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden using the Ring of Distortion to bypass its illusions.

level.objective: Defeat the Whimsical Warden and escape the Enchanted Carnival of Echoes.
level.reward: Crown of Reflections - allows the player to see through illusions and reveals hidden paths in future levels.

level.theme: Chaotic steampunk environment with leaking pipes, overactive machinery, and a sense of urgency as the Core nears activation.
level.setting: A crumbling steampunk laboratory with exposed gears, steam vents, and malfunctioning automatons.
level.player_weapon: Turbine Wrench – a modified wrench with a steam-powered motor that can crack metal plating and release pressure from steam vents.

enemy.name: Steam Tinkerer
enemy.weakness: Turbine Wrench – its steam pipes can be cracked to disable its mobility.

encounters.hazard: A leaking steam pipe can cause a temporary blindness effect on the player if not disarmed.

pickup.name: Pressure Valve Key
pickup.effect: Allows access to locked steam chambers and disables pressure traps.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Tinkerer, the player must use the Pressure Valve Key to open a hidden passage leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Overclocked Golem
enemy.weakness: Pressure Valve Key – inserting it into a control panel causes the golem to short-circuit and stall.

encounters.hazard: The area is filled with rotating gears and molten metal hazards that must be timed to avoid.

pickup.name: Steam Cores
pickup.effect: Power-up the Turbine Wrench, increasing its damage by 20% for the final boss fight.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Golem, the player gains access to the central core chamber, leading to the final boss.

enemy.name: Ironclad Automaton
enemy.weakness: Steam Cores – inserting them into the Automaton's core causes a feedback loop, slowing it and reducing its defenses.

encounters.hazard: The Aether Core is unstable; proximity triggers a countdown to an explosion that can be interrupted with the Turbine Wrench.

pickup.name: Aether Core
pickup.effect: Completes the mission and unlocks a new blueprint for the player.

encounters.trigger: The boss fight is only initiated after the player has acquired both the Pressure Valve Key and the Steam Cores.

boss.name: Ironclad Automaton
boss.weakness: Steam Cores – must be inserted during the final phase to trigger the boss's vulnerability.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss and escape the chamber before the Aether Core explodes.

level.objective: Steal the prototype 'Aether Core' from the Ironclad Research Facility before it's activated.
level.reward: Aether Core, 500 XP, blueprint for a 'Steam Disruptor' weapon

level.theme: Mysterious steampunk city with brass gears, glowing pipes, and ancient machinery, all shrouded in fog and flickering light.
level.setting: The Clockwork Citadel, a once-great city of invention now corrupted by an unknown force.

enemy.name: Golem Warden
enemy.weakness: Arcane Gearforge's overload ability

encounters.hazard: Magnetic Storm

pickup.name: Clockwork Core
pickup.effect: Restores 30% player health and unlocks a temporary shield against energy damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem Warden causes its core to shatter, releasing a pulse that activates a hidden passage leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Scribe Automaton
enemy.weakness: Clockwork Core (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Explosive Scrolls

pickup.name: Chrono Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see hidden mechanisms and enemy weaknesses for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Scribe Automaton's memory cores triggers a countdown sequence leading to the final chamber, where the Clockwork Overlord awaits.

enemy.name: Clockwork Overlord
enemy.weakness: Chrono Lens (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Time Distortion Field

pickup.name: Primeval Mechanism
pickup.effect: Grants permanent +15% damage to Arcane Gearforge and restores full player health.

encounters.trigger: The Overlord's time distortion field must be countered with the Chrono Lens to reveal its core weakness. Defeating it unlocks the Primeval Mechanism, restoring the city’s balance.

boss.name: Clockwork Overlord
boss.weakness: Chrono Lens (obtained in the Brass Archives)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Overlord’s core by targeting its exposed chronal engine, revealed by the Chrono Lens.

level.objective: Navigate the labyrinthine depths of the Clockwork Citadel, uncover its secrets, and defeat the enigmatic Clockwork Overlord who has corrupted the city's machinery.
level.reward: Primeval Mechanism, which permanently upgrades the Arcane Gearforge and restores the city's lost energy grid.

level.setting: A whimsical, mechanical world filled with gears, steam, and alchemical experimentation.

enemy.name: Steam Golem
enemy.weakness: Alchemical Flask of Acidic Gas

encounters.hazard: Pillars of rotating gears and steam vents.

pickup.name: Cracked Cog
pickup.effect: Increases player speed by 10% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Steam Golem, which causes a pressure valve to rupture, releasing steam that triggers the next encounter.

enemy.name: Pressure Drone
enemy.weakness: Cracked Cog

encounters.hazard: Steam vents and flickering lights create a disorienting environment.

pickup.name: Alchemical Catalyst
pickup.effect: Temporarily boosts the Alchemical Flask of Acidic Gas damage by 25% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Pressure Drone unlocks a hidden passage leading to the core chamber and the final boss.

enemy.name: Steam Automaton
enemy.weakness: Alchemical Catalyst

encounters.hazard: Ticking clockwork mechanisms and unstable energy fields.

pickup.name: Recovered Alchemical Core
pickup.effect: Completes the level and grants a permanent +15% damage boost to all alchemical weapons.

encounters.trigger: After the battle, the core powers down and the level is complete.

boss.name: Steam Automaton
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Alchemical Catalyst obtained in the previous encounter.

level.objective: Navigate through the Clockwork Wastes and retrieve the stolen Alchemical Core from the Steam Automaton Boss.
level.reward: Recovered Alchemical Core, +15% damage to alchemical weapons, and 50 experience points for completing the level.

level.theme: A high-stakes, time-sensitive heist in a steampunk factory where every second counts and every misstep could lead to disaster.
level.setting: A massive, steam-powered factory filled with mechanical sentries, clockwork traps, and ticking time limits.

enemy.name: Steam Warden
enemy.weakness: Clockwork Dagger

encounters.hazard: Boiling Steam

pickup.name: Clockwork Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases Clockwork Dagger damage by 15%

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Steam Warden, the factory’s automated defenses activate, leading the player to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Gearslinger
enemy.weakness: Clockwork Catalyst

encounters.hazard: Explosive Oil Pools

pickup.name: Chrono-Resonator
pickup.effect: Disables enemy time-based abilities for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gearslinger, the factory’s central clock tower begins to whir, signaling the arrival of the final boss.

enemy.name: Overlord Vex
enemy.weakness: Chrono-Resonator

encounters.hazard: Traps, Steam Jets, and Energy Fields

pickup.name: Chrono-Gear
pickup.effect: Objective complete. Grants +50% speed and +20% damage for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After weakening the Overlord with the Chrono-Resonator, the vault door opens and the player escapes through a collapsing tunnel.

boss.name: Overlord Vex
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss with the Chrono-Resonator to unlock the Chrono-Gear and escape the level.

level.objective: Steal the Chrono-Gear from the Ironclad Vault and escape the factory alive.

level.theme: Ominous steampunk atmosphere with thunderous skies, rusted machinery, and a sense of impending doom.
level.setting: A once-thriving industrial city now corrupted by uncontrolled lightning, with overgrown metal and shattered gears littering the streets.

enemy.name: Clockwork Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Stormcaller's Rod (lightning damage doubles)

encounters.hazard: Falling gears and debris from collapsing spires

pickup.name: Copper Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases Stormcaller's Rod damage by 25% for the next encounter

encounters.trigger: Defeating the sentinel causes the spire to collapse, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Stormbound Warden
enemy.weakness: Copper Capacitor (damage dealt is increased by 40%)

encounters.hazard: Unstable electrical currents surge across the chamber floor

pickup.name: Ebonium Core
pickup.effect: When used, releases a shockwave that stuns the final boss for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the warden triggers a powerful storm surge, opening the way to the overlord's throne room.

enemy.name: Morvath the Unbound
enemy.weakness: Ebonium Core (only damage that can break Morvath's shield)

encounters.hazard: Arcing lightning bolts from Morvath's gauntlets

pickup.name: Stormforged Amulet
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to lightning damage for 15 seconds and increases player speed

encounters.trigger: After defeating Morvath, the amulet activates, sealing the overlord and restoring balance to the district.

boss.name: Morvath the Unbound
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Morvath using the Ebonium Core to break his shield and deliver the final blow with the Stormcaller's Rod

level.objective: Navigate the cursed steampunk district of Virelthorne and defeat the stormbound overlord, Morvath the Unbound, by strategically using the power of lightning and the relics you recover.
level.reward: Stormforged Amulet (grants temporary lightning immunity and movement boost)

level.theme: Desolate steampunk ruins with flickering gas lamps, rusted gears, and broken time devices.
level.setting: A once-grand clock tower, now frozen in time, with echoes of past events and remnants of failed chronomancy experiments.
level.player_weapon: Chrono Gauntlet (a time-manipulating gauntlet that can slow, rewind, or accelerate time for a short duration)

enemy.name: Time-Devouring Wraith
enemy.weakness: Chrono Gauntlet's 'Time Freeze' ability (the wraith is vulnerable to being trapped in time loops).

encounters.hazard: A broken time-glass is shattered nearby, causing intermittent temporal rifts that may cause the player to be temporarily teleported to the same location.

pickup.name: Chrono Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases Chrono Gauntlet's time manipulation duration by 2 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the wraith, the time-glass shatters completely, causing a chain reaction that opens the path to the next floor.

enemy.name: Frostbound Mechanic
enemy.weakness: Chrono Crystal (the crystal disrupts the mechanic's frost-based time distortion field).

encounters.hazard: The room is frozen in time, but the player can break through the ice using their gauntlet's time acceleration ability.

pickup.name: Rusted Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a sealed door to the next area.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the mechanic, the player uses the Rusted Key to unlock the sealed door, revealing a hidden chamber.

enemy.name: Chrono Engine
enemy.weakness: Chrono Crystal (the engine's core is built from time-forged alloy that only the crystal can disrupt).

encounters.hazard: The engine continuously emits time pulses that cause the player to age or shrink temporarily, with random effects.

pickup.name: Time Anchor
pickup.effect: Stabilizes the player's time state and prevents further age/shrink effects.

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Chrono Crystal at the right moment during the engine's pulse cycle to exploit its weakness and disable it.

boss.name: The Chrono Engine
boss.weakness: Chrono Crystal (the engine's core is built from time-forged alloy that only the crystal can disrupt).
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core using the Chrono Crystal at the moment of a time pulse.

level.objective: Navigate through the abandoned clock tower and neutralize the rogue time engine before it destabilizes the timeline.

level.setting: A decaying, aether-powered citadel deep in the industrial wastelands of the Iron Wastes.
level.player_weapon: Gravitic Prism (aether-infused crystal that manipulates gravity and distorts space)

enemy.name: Chrono Golem
enemy.weakness: Gravitic Prism (damage is doubled when used)

encounters.hazard: Pulsing aether fields that disrupt gravity

pickup.name: Aether Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Increases Gravitic Prism damage by 15 for the next encounter

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Chrono Golem, the aether core fragment activates a hidden mechanism, revealing a passage to the next chamber.

enemy.name: Reflective Automaton
enemy.weakness: Aether Core Fragment (reflects damage back at the enemy)

encounters.hazard: Mirrors that duplicate the player's presence and attack

pickup.name: Clockwork Heart
pickup.effect: Reduces the Clockwork Sovereign's health by 30%

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Reflective Automaton, the Clockwork Heart is dropped, and the mirrors shatter, revealing a path to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Clockwork Sovereign
enemy.weakness: Clockwork Heart (when equipped, the Sovereign's attacks become delayed by 2 seconds)

encounters.hazard: Aether storms and collapsing platforms

pickup.name: Eternal Compass
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to environmental hazards for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the chamber, the Sovereign activates, triggering the aether storm. The player must use the Clockwork Heart to weaken it before it can be defeated.

boss.name: Clockwork Sovereign
boss.weakness: Clockwork Heart (when equipped, the Sovereign's attacks become delayed by 2 seconds)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sovereign with the Clockwork Heart equipped

level.objective: Navigate through the cursed gears of the Blackwork Citadel and dismantle the corrupted automaton, the Clockwork Sovereign.
level.reward: Eternal Compass (grants immunity to environmental hazards for 10 seconds) and access to the next level of the Blackwork Citadel.

level.theme: Serene steampunk environments with soft glowing lights, mechanical flora, and harmonious clockwork elements.
level.setting: A grand steampunk citadel where ancient technology blends with nature, guarded by machines and spirits of the past.
level.player_weapon: Aetheric Light Mace – deals radiant damage and can temporarily illuminate dark areas.

enemy.name: Wraithroot Tendril
enemy.weakness: Radiant energy – damage increased by 50% when struck with the Aetheric Light Mace.

encounters.hazard: Fog of Aether – reduces visibility and makes enemy movements unpredictable.

pickup.name: Aether Crystalline Lens
pickup.effect: Increases the player's light radius by 50%, revealing hidden paths and revealing weak points in subsequent enemies.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wraithroot Tendril, the fog clears, revealing the path to the next area.

enemy.name: Clockwork Warden
enemy.weakness: Mechanical joints – damage increased by 40% if the Aether Crystalline Lens is active.

encounters.hazard: Pulsing Steam Vents – can cause temporary blindness if the player is caught in the blast.

pickup.name: Brass Relic Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber and allows access to the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Clockwork Warden unlocks the central door, leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Aether Sovereign (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Core Vulnerability – damage increased by 75% if the player uses the Brass Relic Key to target its core.

encounters.hazard: Drifting Aether Vortex – can randomly teleport the player or enemy across the battlefield.

pickup.name: Aetheric Light Core
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and permanently increases the damage of the Aetheric Light Mace by 20%.

encounters.trigger: The Brass Relic Key must be used on the Sovereign's core to weaken it for the final strike.

boss.name: The Aether Sovereign
boss.weakness: Core Vulnerability – damage increased by 75% if the player uses the Brass Relic Key to target its core.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Sovereign's core using the Brass Relic Key during a critical moment.

level.objective: Restore the ancient steampunk beacon to prevent the city from falling into darkness.
level.reward: Aetheric Light Core – boosts the player's radiant damage and healing abilities for future quests.
